title: ¿Quién está en la arena? 🚒🐢 | #shorts
world: sunny beach: soft golden sand, turquoise waves, palm trees and a red-and-white lighthouse + the wet shoreline with gentle foam
story: Two big eyes open and blink inside a huge sand mound on the beach (mystery in second 0)
Rojito races along the shore toward the mound, siren flashing (the call)
He sprays a water arc on the mound and the sand washes away (the try)
A pale-yellow flipper pokes out of the wet sand and wiggles (clue 1)
A little pale-yellow tail pops out at the back and wiggles (clue 2)
Reveal: a big friendly sea turtle, clean and shiny, smiles at Rojito (twist)
The turtle crawls into the waves and waves goodbye with a flipper (reward)
Next to Rojito's wheel, a small new sand mound blinks two tiny eyes (loop: who now?)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¡Dos ojitos en la arena!
[Verse]
¿De quién son? ¡Nii-noo!
¡Splash! ¡Agua, fuera arena!
¿Una patita? ¡Sí, sí!
¿Una colita? ¡Sí, sí!
[Chorus]
¡Es una tortuga! ¡Hola, hola!
¡Al mar, tortuga! ¡Adiós!
[Outro]
¿Y ahora quién? ¡Uy!

locations.playa: A sunny beach outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: soft smooth golden sand with one huge round sand mound in the middle, gentle turquoise waves with white foam, two leaning palm trees, a small red-and-white striped lighthouse far away, a wide open blue sky with white clouds. No vehicles on the beach.
locations.orilla: The wet shoreline of a sunny beach outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: shiny wet golden sand, small turquoise waves rolling in with white foam, little shells, a wide open blue sky. No vehicles on the shore.

shots: Extreme close-up of a huge round mound of golden sand on the beach: two big friendly glossy eyes are open in the sand and blinking, little grains of sand trickling down around them, the front bumper of the little red fire truck character visible at the bottom edge of the picture.
The two eyes in the sand blink slowly and sand trickles down the mound.

Wide shot of the sunny beach: the little red fire truck character drives along the golden sand toward the huge round sand mound, his round blue siren FLASHING BRIGHT BLUE, palm trees and the turquoise sea behind.
He drives toward the sand mound, his siren flashing.

Low side view at ground level: the little red fire truck character sprays a long arc of sparkling water from the little hose on his ladder onto the huge sand mound, wet sand sliding down the mound in streams.
The water arc hits the mound and wet sand slides down in streams.

Close-up at the bottom of the wet sand mound: one PALE-YELLOW sea-turtle flipper with little peach spots now pokes out of the wet golden sand and wiggles, water drops sparkling, the little red fire truck character's front wheel at the edge of the picture.
The pale-yellow flipper wiggles out of the wet sand, drops falling off it.

View from behind the little red fire truck character spraying water: at the back of the wet sand mound a small PALE-YELLOW tail now pokes out and wiggles, most of the sand washed away, revealing part of a round peach-orange shell.
The little pale-yellow tail wiggles while the water keeps washing the sand away.

Medium shot, front three-quarter view on the beach: a big round friendly sea turtle with a shiny clean PEACH-ORANGE shell covered in soft yellow hexagon spots, pale-yellow skin, round rosy cheeks and big glossy eyes, its head out and a big smile, stands where the sand mound was, the little red fire truck character beside it smiling, a few wet sand grains around.
The sea turtle stretches its head out and smiles, he smiles back.

Top-down view from above the shoreline: the big peach-orange sea turtle crawls into the gentle turquoise waves, lifting one flipper to wave goodbye, the little red fire truck character parked on the wet sand at the bottom of the picture.
The turtle crawls into the waves and lifts a flipper to wave goodbye.

Close-up, low angle on the wet sand next to the little red fire truck character's front wheel: a small new sand mound with two tiny glossy eyes blinking in it, the little fire truck looking down at it with wide surprised eyes.
The tiny eyes in the small mound blink and he looks down, surprised.

hero.who: The little red fire truck character
hero.one: Only one vehicle character in the picture.

style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: ROJITO, a cute little red toy fire truck character with a friendly face: a short chubby rounded body like a toddler toy, shiny cherry-red paint, a big curved windshield with two big glossy dark-brown cartoon eyes with white sparkle highlights and expressive eyebrows, a small smiling mouth on the front bumper, rosy pink cheeks on the front, a small white ladder on the roof, one round blue siren light on top, a golden bell on the front, a small number 1 in a yellow circle on each door.
twist: the 'sand monster' with blinking eyes is a friendly sea turtle — each spray reveals one more clue (flipper, tail, shell) before the full reveal
moral: ¡Rojito ayuda a todos sus amigos, hasta en la playa!
experiment: first 'mystery' pattern (Huella Mágica ×1,150) as a clue-by-clue reveal with water; giant-thing-to-clean hook (Diente Gigante ×26, +3.9M in 12 h)
continuity: sunny midday in every shot; Rojito cherry red, siren FLASHING only in A2; water arc in A3 and A5; sand mound: full with eyes A1-A2, washing A3, flipper A4, tail + shell A5, gone A6; turtle clean from A6, in the waves A7; small new mound only A8; playa = A1-A6, orilla = A7-A8
